resource_policy: Resolve a unique cgroup-v2 membership and mount mapping from /proc/self/cgroup and mountinfo, including escaped mount paths.
Take the minimum of host MemAvailable and each finite visible current/ancestor remaining memory limit. A child max value never erases a parent cap.

Missing both memory interface files is accepted only at a visible hierarchy root whose mount-root field is slash; report host plus other observable limits and explicitly unknown invisible ancestors. A nonroot bind mount with missing files, partial pairs, invalid values, traversal or ambiguous mappings yields zero headroom.
Neither host-only observation nor cgroup remaining memory is asserted to be a future memory guarantee or physical-CPU support bound.
